what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sudan in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 999 Sudanese asylum seekers in Canada, 0.1% of all asylum seekers from Sudan.
Refugees from Sudan, a separate group, live mostly in Chad, South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan in periods from 1995 to 2025, with the RSF among the opponents since 2020.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 332 asylum seekers and fell to a low in 2005.
The figure was at its highest, 1156, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2019 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
